THE DESTINATION

About Manali & Kasol

Nestled in the heart of Himachal Pradesh, Manali is a magical hill station known for its snow-covered peaks, pine forests, vibrant cafes, and thrilling adventures. It's the perfect blend of scenic beauty and cultural charm. Just beyond the Atal Tunnel lies Sissu, a hidden gem of Lahaul Valley offering breathtaking views of glaciers, rivers, and green meadows.

On your way back, you'll explore Kasol — the backpacker's paradise, surrounded by the Parvati River and lush green hills. Visit Manikaran Sahib, famous for its spiritual aura and hot springs, making it a perfect end to your Himalayan journey.

WHAT AWAITS YOU

Major Trip Highlights

Scenic road journey — through the Himalayas, Delhi to Manali and back.

Manali local exploration — Hadimba Temple, Old Manali & Mall Road.

Snow adventures at Solang Valley — breathtaking mountain views.

Drive through the iconic Atal Tunnel — an engineering marvel.

Sissu — the Mini Switzerland of India, in the Lahaul Valley.

Spiritual visit to Manikaran Sahib — hot springs and serene vibes.

Bonfire and music nights — with the group, under the mountain sky.

Experienced Trip Captain — and 24x7 support throughout the trip.

DAY BY DAY

Your Itinerary

  • Assembly: Assemble at Akshardham Metro Station by 8:00 PM.
  • Briefing: Meet your trip coordinator for a short briefing.
  • Journey: Begin overnight journey to Manali via AC Traveller / Bus.
  • En Route: Stops for meals / snacks (at your own cost).
  • Arrival: Arrive in Manali, check into your hotel & freshen up.
  • Sightseeing: Visit Hadimba Temple, Old Manali & Mall Road.
  • Return: Return to hotel.
  • Evening: Enjoy bonfire & music night with dinner.
  • Overnight Stay: In Manali.
  • Post Breakfast: Head to Solang Valley for breathtaking mountain views & snow fun.
  • Drive: Drive through Atal Tunnel — an engineering marvel.
  • Sissu: Reach Sissu and enjoy the scenic beauty of Lahaul Valley.
  • Return: Return to hotel by evening.
  • Overnight Stay: Dinner and overnight stay in Manali.
  • Morning: Early breakfast & hotel checkout.
  • Drive: Drive to Kasol & Manikaran.
  • Explore: Explore Manikaran hot springs & serene vibes.
  • Market: Stroll around Kasol market.
  • Departure: Departure for Delhi by late evening.
WHAT YOU PAY FOR

Inclusions & Exclusions

Included in your package

  • Meals: 4 (2 breakfast + 2 dinner)
  • 2 nights stay at a scenic hotel in Manali
  • Comfortable AC Traveller / Bus for all transfers
  • Trip Captain for the entire journey
  • Bonfire + light music (subject to weather)
  • Sightseeing as per itinerary
  • 24x7 support throughout the trip

Not included in your package

  • Any meals not mentioned in the inclusions list
  • Entry tickets for monuments, lakes, palaces, monasteries, rafting, zip-line, etc.
  • Early check-in at hotels
  • Additional services like room heaters
  • Personal expenses of any kind
  • Meals during travel or sightseeing
  • Tips, laundry, wines, liquor, mineral water
  • Adventure activity costs not listed in inclusions
